note: Jennings County Area Planning publishes only the zoning ordinance as text PDF and no zoning district map layer. No ArcGIS REST, WFS or bulk download of zoning districts found for the county. The county GIS viewer (jenningsin.wthgis.com) exposes no discoverable zoning service. North Vernon defers zoning to the county Area Plan Commission, so no city layers were found either. Only third-party zoning sites (zoneomics) draw district maps.
